messages.text: The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Fixed best scores so that a completed game replaces a saved score only when it uses fewer moves. Board sizes without a completed game now show “none,” including after reload.

All 140 unit tests passed. The browser suite passed 76 of 77 checks; the remaining face-art check timed out during the full run and passed when rerun alone. Formatting passed for the changed files. The repository-wide formatting check still reports three unrelated, unchanged files.
